# A loop of queries whose list a search empties until the search's `@update`
# fills it again. Each copy's query keeps its cells per copy, begun by an
# enter bracket the settle ran ahead of the reports: the enter saw the empty
# list, the report then wrote what the list reads, and the downs and ups saw
# every copy stay. The next pass began the cells of every copy afresh under
# queries still running, so each answer was stale and nothing asked again --
# bubbletea's Pokédex never named the species a search covers. Reports now
# run before the enters.
#
# The fetch waits on the script harness's server.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// The length of `key`, asked of the script harness's server.
func lookup(key string) async.Result[int] {
    match var r = http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/200") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok { return {ok=key.length()} }
    }
}

var answers map[string, int] = {}

component page ui.node {
    var search = ""
    var all = false

    // The keys asked for: two until a search, every one once a search has
    // asked for all. Between the search and its `@update` there are none.
    func keys() list[string] {
        if all {
            return ["one", "two", "three"]
        }
        return search == "" ? ["one", "two"] : []
    }

    effect(on=search, @update {
        if search != "" {
            all = true
        }
    })
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #find(text="find", @click { search = "t" })
        for var k = keys() {
            if !answers.contains(k) {
                async.query(on=k, fetch=lookup, @load(got) { answers[k] = got })
            }
        }
    }
}

func testASearchAsksForEveryKey(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.find.click()
    t.wait(func() => answers.length() == 3, 5000)
    t.assert(answers["one"] == 3 && answers["two"] == 3 && answers["three"] == 5)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
